emails.subject: Research Progress Update
emails.body:
Hi Dawei,

I wanted to update you on the current status of our research project. We've made significant progress on the algorithms, and I've attached the latest results for your review. Please have a look and let me know your thoughts.

Best regards,
Kevin

Thank you for the update, Kevin. I've added an updated graph to the results which should help in visualizing the data trends more clearly. Please see the attached file and let me know if you need further modifications.

Best,
Stefan
